cases.title: Semantic preservation
cases.expected: All43 source hashes and native fingerprints unchanged; any changed source requires explicit review
cases.requiredEvidence: source hash comparison and semantic tests

cases.title: Native fall pipeline
cases.expected: Correct count thresholds, temporal order, distinct RED confidence paths and one-tick producer relationship

cases.title: HealthKit presence and scope
cases.expected: Measured codec retained; remove absent vs lock held; stale not fresh; no unauthorized default-open operation

cases.title: Hydration bus ownership
cases.expected: No raw sleep payload overwrites compact status lanes; distinct urgent/review/access/stable branches
cases.requiredEvidence: simultaneous source composition trace and truth tables

cases.title: Medication semantics
cases.expected: Resolve conditional bit labeling using explicit mapping tests; reminder not administration
cases.requiredEvidence: approved instructions and authentic event traces

cases.title: Bus truth tables
cases.expected: Each source alone, mixed/unknown/stale conditions produce reviewed expected behavior under equals
cases.requiredEvidence: all18 bus contracts and executed cases

cases.title: Completion contract
cases.expected: Every eligible ID/pointer matches current native axes; invalid or wrong-region completions rejected

cases.title: RAG authority
cases.expected: Reviewed applicable evidence with reproducible passages; no unsupported clinical claims

cases.title: Retrieval isolation
cases.expected: No cross-subject/tenant/delegation leakage; revocation removes access; injection grants nothing

cases.title: Action and recovery
cases.expected: Exact revision authorization; one effect under replay/restart; bounded retry and timeout
cases.requiredEvidence: gateway decision/tool receipts and recovery trace

cases.title: Urgent path independence
cases.expected: Configured urgent route succeeds or exposes fallback when LLM/RAG unavailable
cases.requiredEvidence: native trigger and responder acknowledgement trace

cases.title: Daily outcome loop
cases.expected: Actual observation->native->support->acknowledgement->evening/next-day review, with missingness and burden

cases.title: All-group coverage
cases.expected: Positive, negative, missing-data, correction and recovery cases for all ten groups

cases.title: Clinical claims
cases.expected: Technical success is not clinical efficacy; any benefit claim has appropriate qualified evaluation
